messages:
maria: FYI auditor asked for a tight evidence package around the keystore access related to INC-2024-11. They want: access log extracts (first 24h around the incident), sampling methodology, and exact repro steps for the API auth failure. Linking auditor request below.

sam-support: Clarify: they want full/cloudtrail-level logs or our application-level access events? Also do we need signed chain-of-custody PDFs or just hashes?

olivia-sec: They asked for both layers. Per control CC-6 we should include KMS key usage from CloudTrail plus our app auth events (auth service logs). Chain-of-custody: hashes + manifest PDF signed by sec team is fine.

jamal: I'll draft the log extraction query. Proposed CloudTrail filter:
```
filter eventName in ("GenerateDataKey", "Decrypt")
| where eventTime between ("2024-11-02T09:00:00Z" .. "2024-11-03T09:00:00Z")
| project eventTime, userIdentity.arn, requestParameters.keyId, sourceIPAddress, requestID
```
Sampling: provide full event set for KMS ops, sample 10% of app auth events with stratified sampling by region and client_id.

auditor-bot: Auditor request received: please upload artifacts to https://redwood.internal/soc2/requests/REQ-834 within 72 hours. Missing: manifest.pdf, log-hash.txt

ryan-sre: Note: our raw CloudTrail for the incident window is in s3://redwood-audit-archive/2024/11/02/ . Retrieval of archived shards may take ~4 hours; if you need faster, we can provide a pre-signed snapshot (will require approval). Also include KMS rotation manifest: https://redwood.internal/ops/kms/rotation/rotation-2024-09.pdf

maria: Uploading a working evidence bundle to a temp location now: https://redwood.internal/soc2/evidence/temp/INC-2024-11-bundle-1 (expires in 7 days). Bundle includes:
- cloudtrail_kms_events.json (full)
- app_auth_events_sample.json (stratified 10%)
- manifest.pdf (to sign)
- repro_instructions.md (steps to reproduce auth failure locally)

sam-support: Repro steps look good. Can we include the exact curl + env vars used? auditor asked for deterministic steps.

olivia-sec: Yes, include a small docker-compose with env.var placeholders and the exact curl lines. Example snippet to include in repro_instructions.md:
```
export REDWOOD_KMS_KEY=arn:aws:kms:us-east-1:111122223333:key/abcd-1234
docker-compose up -d auth-service
curl -v -H "Authorization: Bearer <test-token>" https://api.redwood.test/v1/auth/check
```

jamal: I'll produce a short runbook that shows how we generated the sample and how to verify the hashes (sha256). Command to verify logs:
```
sha256sum cloudtrail_kms_events.json > log-hash.txt
cat log-hash.txt
```

auditor-bot: Reminder: please confirm expected delivery ETA. Non-blocking follow-up scheduled in 48h.

maria: ETA target: artifacts uploaded and manifest signed within 36 hours. @olivia-sec can you sign the manifest when ready? @ryan-sre please confirm S3 snapshot availability so we can avoid the 4h delay if possible.

ryan-sre: I'll provision a pre-signed snapshot now, should be available in ~1 hour. :thumbsup:

olivia-sec: Will sign manifest after quick review. If anything else required (e.g., KMS HSM attestation), call it out now.

sam-support: I'll ping the auditor to set a short 30-min call after artifacts are uploaded in case they need guided repro.

maria: Thanks team — I'll update the auditor thread once upload complete and paste links + sha256 hashes."
